verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS developer platform like GitHub Copilot, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
